title: cleome maculata
intro: Cleome maculata, commonly known as Spurred Coral Tree, is a plant species native to tropical regions of Asia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Cleome maculata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
